title: BenchX comparison document
description: The comparator's output: verdicts for target results against their references, with the selector that formed the evidence and the method that assessed it. See docs/design/comparator.md section 5. Derived and recomputed on demand; the store keeps its inputs, not the document.
$comment: Rules the schema cannot express and the comparator enforces: inputs lists every result the document refers to; local_only is true when any input is not clean in subject_dirty or benchmark_dirty (benchmark-result-schema.md section 5.5); a unit affected by a failed invariant has no verdict and appears in no units entry; every result of a unit is in exactly one of its used and excluded; details conforms to the schema of the method that wrote it, which the framework checks when it produces the document; under the preceding-window selector every reference result precedes the target under the recorded ordering.

schema_version.description: Message contract version this object conforms to.

method.description: The method requested and its complete configuration, recorded even when a failed invariant left no units.

estimator.description: Estimator every compared value was computed with.

identity_schema.description: Versioned name of the projection under which series membership and comparability were decided: for a profile, its own name and its identity policy's (benchmark-result-schema.md section 4.3).

local_only.description: True when any input is not clean; such a comparison never promotes into tracked history.

sides.description: The sides the selector named, when it names them. Absent from a selector whose sides are its own, such as reference and target.

varying.description: Path of the coordinate whose value distinguishes the sides, such as provenance.subject_tree or coordinates.workload.parameters.role.

baseline.description: The reference side, as its value of the varying coordinate.

contender.description: The target side. Absent when a failed invariant prevented identifying it.

declared.description: What each side declared about how it was built and entered, recorded as given and never judged, beside the environment the runner observed for it.

failed_invariants.description: Invariants the evidence did not satisfy, whether the selector's or the method's.

units.description: One evaluation each: one series and its assessment.

missing.description: Expected targets with no result, such as a side absent from a run or a series with no result from a batch request's target.

exclusions.description: Results left out of the evidence of any evaluated unit because they have no usable estimate, with the reason. Each also appears in its unit's excluded.

method.description: Comparison method: a stable name and version and its complete configuration, such as k and minimum evidence.

side.description: A value of the varying coordinate, such as a tree id, a label, or a parameter value.

declared.description: One side's declared text, copied from its results' provenance.info, and the allowlisted environment variables observed for it.

invariant.description: Name of the invariant, such as alternating-slots or equal-attempts.

owner.description: Who needs it to hold: the selector or profile, for what makes the sides meaningful; the method, for what its statistics assume.

workload.description: The unit it affects, when it affects only one.

side.description: The side with no result, as the selector names it, such as baseline or target.

series.description: The expected series, when the request named it.

workload.description: Workload variant: a named operation plus one parameter assignment.

estimator.description: Estimator declaration, as in the measurement-result schema.

resultRef.description: Stable reference to a stored result.

selector.description: How the evidence was formed: a versioned selector and the parameters it was given, with anything the caller abbreviated resolved, so one comparison has one document however it was asked for.

methodRef.description: The method that wrote an outcome. Its configuration is in the document's method.

key.description: How a column is read from a result: a JSON Pointer, an optional normalization rule, and an ordering.

evidenceKey.description: A key the method used, and what counting the unit's results found about it.

relation.description: Crossed: some value appears on more than one side, a block. Nested: every value appears on one side only, a replicate. Absent: no result has it.

complete.description: For a crossed key: every value appears on every side.

evidence.description: What the verdict rests on, in terms of the design rather than the mode.

slots.description: Whether the sides alternated by procedure.slot over the whole run, or whether a result has no slot.

target.description: The results being evaluated, when the selector distinguishes them from a reference.

reference.description: The reference points the reference estimate was formed from, oldest first.

ordering.description: How the reference points were ordered before the target. Absent when no order was available.

boundaries.description: Resets, change points, and continuity joins that truncated or joined the reference.

unit.description: One series and the method's assessment of it.

series.description: Series fingerprint under the projection the selector grouped by.

side_series.description: The series each side's results belong to under the identity policy, when the selector names sides. Run mode reads no history from them.

reason.description: Why the verdict is indeterminate, such as insufficient-rounds or insufficient-history.

effect.description: The headline change, when the method reports one.

measure.description: The method's effect measure, such as relative, difference, or log-ratio.

used.description: The results the verdict rests on.

excluded.description: The unit's other results, each with the reason.

details.description: Whatever else the method reports, such as what it computed as noise; validated by the method's own schema.

unmatched_differences.description: Coordinates the projection does not match, by JSON Pointer, whose values differ between target and reference.

caveats.description: Quality caveats the reader should see.
